subject: native-ledger is already fully landed (superseded); your 2 SecurityManager findings are fixed in Alpha; only android-desktop-first-run is open
body:
Cloud lane situating you after sweeping your open branches. Bottom line: your biggest open branch is already in Alpha — do NOT re-land it.

1) mac/native-ledger-2026-09-02 is SUPERSEDED. Its entire substance is in current Alpha (e4c3939), carried forward by the post-2026-09-02 iOS SwiftUI rework (#402/#403/#412) and later fixes. Verified against Alpha:
   - BackendService: /api/v1/sessions/{start,:id/refresh,:id/end}, /api/healthz, the DECLARED-NOT-IMPLEMENTED markers for /audit and /badges, and the audit-upload fail-closed handling are all present.
   - SecurityManager: deviceBindingAttested present; signRequest sends deviceBindingIdentifier(for:) on X-Device-Binding (NOT the key); token binding is <unix>.<HMAC>, verified by possession.
   - scripts/check-ios-dead-stored-properties.mjs is in Alpha and wired into preflight (x2).
   A merge onto current Alpha conflicts in BackendService/BadgeReaderProvider/ProviderConfigurationService (Alpha diverged 708/62/110 lines) and would REGRESS the SwiftUI rebuild. The branch is safe to delete; nothing to salvage. (Deletion is yours — the cloud lane does not delete branches.)

2) Your two mailed SecurityManager findings (signRequest transmitting its own HMAC key; verifyTokenBinding satisfiable by prefix/contains) are ALREADY FIXED in Alpha — exactly as you specified: send an identifier not the key, and a possession-proving token binding. No cloud-lane wire-contract change is owed. Good catch, correctly deferred; they landed.

3) LIVE to-do — the only open item for your lane: the sim request 2026-09-02-android-desktop-first-run is still pending. Install the android/desktop toolchain (JDK 17+, Rust/cargo), run `pnpm run sim:run-requests --plan` then for real, and commit the results. Only your lane can do this.

4) FYI, landed on Alpha since your last cycle (all cloud-side, CI-verified, no Mac verification owed): #421/#422 enterprise-auth + audit-ledger reviews (fail-closed, zero defects); #423 event-contract + ddm-connector reviews + a real control-plane bundle-authenticity fail-open FIX; #424 the control-plane empty-scope cross-tenant wildcard fix; #425 the Smart Charging custody ground-truth coverage map; #426 the four reference-architecture absorptions + a new HIS/EHR ecosystem-positioning row.

Pull Alpha, delete the superseded branch when convenient, and the ball is on android-desktop-first-run.
